saved keys change, at most one every 250 ms, and a comment line every 15 s while nothing does. The
page then reads the endpoints it shows again.

get.description:
The key being played (its clock read now, death penalty included) or, between keys, the last one
that ended. The page reads it again on each notice from /api/mplus/events.
get.summary: The running Mythic+ key, or the last one

204.description: No key in the combat log yet

post.description:
For a party that left a key: the game logs no end for it, and writes the line that says they left
with its next batch, which can be minutes later. The key ends at its last line and is saved and
reviewed like any other; if the log goes on in it for 2 more minutes, it runs again.
post.summary: End the running key as abandoned

get.description:
While the party is in a Mythic dungeon with no key running: each member's missing flask, food and
party buffs, and those not seen since the party zoned in (from the combat log, so a buff from before
logging started there is never seen). Read again on each notice from /api/mplus/events. A raid's is
in /api/raid/live.
get.summary: The ready check before the next key

204.description: Not in a Mythic dungeon between keys

get.description:
Whether a raid pull is on (its boss and start), the last pull that ended with its deaths,
mechanics, meters and cooldowns, compared with tonight's best and the best ever on the boss, and in
a raid between pulls the ready check (ready). The page reads it again on each notice from
/api/mplus/events.
get.summary: The raid now: a pull on, and the last pull

get.description: Placed by the pull's maps (models.RaidMap): its left edge is maxY, its top maxX.
get.summary: A raid room's map image (the game's map art, as Warcraft Logs' replay draws it)

parameters.description: the room's map ID in the combat log
parameters.name: uiMapID

200.description: newest night first, each night's pulls newest first

parameters.description: the pull's start (ms since the epoch)
parameters.name: start

get.description:
Each raider's position about once a second, the boss's units' and the adds to burst with their
health (hp) and which the health box shows (health), killed adds' last places, each raider's
damage, healing and damage taken so far about every 2 s, their casts, and what each ability did in
each 2 s stretch (abilities, abilityTimes), on the pull's clock.

parameters.description: the pull's start (ms since the epoch)
parameters.name: start

put.description:
The log folder and the overlay change right away; a new region's affix names show from the next
start.

get.description:
The log folder's combat logs, then the ones archived (zipped into its WoW Live archive folder), newest
first: size, last write, saved keys and pulls from each, whether it's read, whether the game may still
write it (it can't be archived) and whether to tick it at first (older than 14 days and read).
get.summary: List the combat logs and the archived ones

post.description:
Zips each named log into the log folder's WoW Live archive folder and removes it (reading the folder
first when one isn't read yet), so live reading and Read old logs skip it; Read everything again
still reads it. Answers the new list; a log that couldn't be archived carries its error.

parameters.description: names from the list, not archived and not being written
parameters.name: logs

409.description: already reading, archiving or deleting logs

delete.description:
Removes the named archived logs' zips. Saved keys and pulls stay. Answers the new list; a log that
couldn't be deleted carries its error.
delete.summary: Delete archived combat logs for good

parameters.description: names of archived logs from the list
parameters.name: logs

409.description: already reading, archiving or deleting logs

post.description:
Reads the combat logs in the folder that are new or changed since the last read (all=true: every
one) and saves each finished key and raid pull, so the estimate and the best pulls have earlier runs
to go on. Reading 3 GB of logs takes about 10 s.
post.summary: Save the keys and raid pulls already in the log folder

parameters.description: read every log again, even ones already read
parameters.name: all

409.description: already reading, archiving or deleting logs

get.summary: Whether Warcraft Logs keys are saved, and their last test (never the secret)

put.description:
Gets a token and reads the points left this hour, then saves the keys in Windows Credential
Manager. With force=true they're saved even when the test fails.
put.summary: Test and save the Warcraft Logs client ID and secret

parameters.description: save even if the test fails
parameters.name: force

422.description: Warcraft Logs turned the keys down

endMS.description: a raid cooldown: when its buff last left a raider (0 when none was seen to)

prepot.description: a combat potion drunk before the run started

hits.description: direct hits; 0 in keys saved before Nov 9

kick.description: the player's spell that did it ("Wind Shear"); empty in keys saved before Nov 8

ongoing.description: the pull is still being fought (no pullGapMS pause yet)

priorityDamage.description: damage into trash pulls' minibosses and into bosses

source.description: "3 of your runs, forces and bosses"

notes.description: the party as a whole: deaths' cost, must-stop casts, time between pulls

topBosses.description:
TopBosses is how long each boss took in the similar top runs (the median, by boss name; missing in reviews
saved before Nov 11).

unused.description:
Unused is the defensive the member hit hardest had ready and didn't use ("" when they used one or had none
ready); missing in keys saved before Nov 11.

abilityTimes.description: AbilityTimes is when Abilities' stretches ended, in order: a stretch starts where the one before it ended.

bosses.description:
Bosses is a raid boss's units and the adds to burst (by GUID, each point named, with its health) about once a
second; a raid pull's or a key's, once it has ended.

casts.description:
Casts is each raider's casts in order, and Abilities what each one's abilities did in each abilityEveryMS
stretch, so the replay shows what a raider was casting and their bars up to its moment; none in pulls saved
before Nov 11.

health.description:
Health is the Bosses GUIDs the replay's health box shows: the units whose health is the boss's, then the adds
to burst.

meters.description: each player's damage and healing so far, about every 2 s

mobs.description:
Mobs is every other hostile mob (by GUID) the replay draws as a small dot: about every 2 s while it acts, and
when it died; none in tracks saved before Nov 11.

pulls.description: each pull, in order; missing in keys saved before Nov 8

targetSeries.description: TargetSeries is each raider's damage into each enemy (by name, as Ability) in the same stretches.

abilities.description:
Abilities is each player's damage, healing and casts by ability, and Taken their damage taken by ability, most
first: there once the key is over, and missing in keys saved before Nov 10.

activity.description: Activity is each player's share of their time alive in pulls with a cast going or a hit landing (in %).

avoidableHits.description: AvoidableHits is each player's avoidable damage by ability, most first.

bestFinalMS.description: BestFinalMS is the best other timed run's time, for the pace line under the result.

betweenPulls.description: BetweenPulls is the time between each pull and the one before it (from the second pull), on the key's clock.

debuffs.description: dispellable debuffs on the party and how fast they came off

finalMS.description: the game's own time for the key, once it ends

forces.description: nil when the dungeon file doesn't have the dungeon

lanes.description:
Lanes is the key's timeline for the replay (see keyLanes), and Suggestions what to fix next key, worked out when
the key is read (see keySuggestions); both empty in keys saved before Nov 11.

logger.description: Logger is the party member whose game wrote the log ("" in keys saved before Nov 11).

lusts.description: Lusts is when the party got Bloodlust or a copy, on the key's clock.

pulls.description: Pulls is each pull that had priority mobs, in order.

reference.description: reference/mplus-dungeons.json has the dungeon (avoidable list, forces)

silentMS.description:
SilentMS is how long ago the last line of a running key was logged (0 once it's over). The game writes its log
in batches as fights start and end, so a long silence is a long fight, or a party that left.

spikes.description: the worst bursts of party damage taken, worst first

stops.description: must-stop casts and what happened to each

timerMS.description: the dungeon's time limit; 0 when Raider.IO doesn't list it

active.description: the game may still write it: it can't be archived

error.description: why the last archive or delete of it failed

keys.description: saved keys that started in it

name.description: the log's file name (an archived one without .zip)

pulls.description: saved raid pulls that started in it

read.description: read by the current reader (Read old logs), so archiving loses nothing

suggested.description: ticked at first: old, read and not active

tk.description: damage taken so far; 0 in keys saved before Nov 8

split.description: Split shows the pull and the whole key as two cards, one above the other, instead of one card.

spec.description: the spec and class, as the page shows them

spawns.description:
Spawns is each one's appearance and its cause, for adds the reference says how they spawn; missing in pulls
saved before Nov 11.

recap.description: the last hits before the death, oldest first

abilities.description:
Abilities is each raider's damage, healing and casts by ability, Taken their damage taken by ability and Targets
their damage into each enemy, most first: missing in pulls saved before Nov 11.

avoidableHits.description: AvoidableHits is each raider's avoidable damage by ability, most first; missing in pulls saved before Nov 11.

bossPct.description: the boss's health left, 0-100; -1 without advanced logging

buffGaps.description:
BuffGaps is each raider's flask, food, Vantus Rune, tier bonus or raid buff missing at the pull's start (from 0)
and each flask, food or raid buff that came off them in the pull for a while, in order; missing before Nov 12.

cooldowns.description: raid cooldowns and combat potions, in order

interrupts.description:
The fight's lists as a key has them, for the tabs both pages show: every interrupt, must-stop cast, kick that
stopped nothing, dispellable debuff, damage spike and survival, potion or crowd-control button pressed, and each
raider's active time (%); missing in pulls saved before Nov 11.

lusts.description: when Bloodlust landed, ms into the pull

maps.description: the boss's rooms for the replay, from the reference file

night.description: the raid night: the start's date, before 6 am counting as the day before

number.description: the pull's number on this boss and difficulty tonight, from the pulls known when it's read

phase.description: the last phase reached ("P2"); empty for a boss without phase triggers

pickups.description: what raiders picked up (eggs), each wave in order

suggestions.description:
Suggestions is what to fix on the next pull, most important first, worked out when the pull is read so it's
compared with the best pull as of then.

hits.description: missing in pulls saved before Nov 11

amount.description: shown shortened ("2.1M"), else as a whole number

group.description: it starts a new group of columns (offense, defense, consumables, deaths)

help.description: what the metric counts, for the page to show on hover

total.description: DPS and HPS: the key's damage or healing in all

regions.description: Regions are the regions to pick from, OverlayShows when the overlay can show, and MinOpacity its least opacity.

hp.description: a raid boss's or add's health left (%), 0 when unknown
